description: This file contains extension methods for configuring storage features within Orleans silo builder, specifically registering storage factory and attribute mapper services.

classes.name: ExampleStorageExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods for setting up example storage services in Orleans silo configuration.

methods.name: UseExampleStorage
methods.description: Configures services to add a named example storage factory and an attribute to factory mapper.

methods.name: UseAsDefaultExampleStorage
methods.description: Configures services to register a given factory type as the default example storage factory.
